title: The Grunion Run, 2008 · before
logline: The day before the eleventh run: a letter at Gully's, addressed to the strip care of the shack, from a Newport reader saying he'll be at the run with the clipping. Gully reads it aloud. Wood asks him not to. Gully reads the last line anyway.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY with an opened letter. WOOD on the stool with his hand over his eyes. BARNABY.

balloons.text: 'Care of the bait shack.' That's you.
